About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Vemuram Shanks 4K Back to results Vemuram Shanks 4K Fuzz Boost Germanium Fuzz Face-style pedal recreating 60s fuzz with modern headroom. 9V only. The Shanks 4K was designed to recreate the classic 60s Fuzz Face overdrive/boost sound using vintage germanium transistors. The 4K designation refers to its four knobs: Level, Fuzz, Bass, and Treble, offering more tonal control than vintage two-knob designs. Two vintage germanium transistors deliver authentic Fuzz Face character, while a modern output circuit provides higher headroom than original designs. The Fuzz Color trim potentiometer on the front of the solid brass housing allows precise adjustment of the distortion character. The tonal range is exceptionally wide, from firm and bright clean tones to edgy, crunchy boost and full-on vintage fuzz. Controls include Level, Fuzz, Bass, and Treble, plus the front-mounted Fuzz Color trimmer. IMPORTANT: Do not use higher voltage than 9V with this pedal - it is specifically created and designed for 9V operation only. The germanium circuit provides touch-sensitive response that cleans up beautifully with your guitar's volume knob. The Shanks 4K was designed to recreate the 60’s Fuzz Face like overdrive boost. Equipped with two vintage germanium transistors. The range of the tone is very wide and has a enough head room to obtain a firm and bright clean tone to an edgy crunchy boost. When turning the FUZZ and the BASS to the highest level will get a thick Fuzz Face like distortion. The Fuzz Color trimmer allows to control the fuzz tone from spitty fuzz to a smooth overdrive fuzz. John Shanks Comment “Unlike the creamy distortion of an overdrive, we went for the Hendrix/Jimmy Page tone. The earthquake like distortion you get when you attack the strings, but when played sensitively, it gives off a nice clean tone with an edgy crunch.
